name: Light Fildora
source:
Likes: Tidy rooms
Dislikes: Office work
Hobby: Training
Skills: Swordsmanship, cooking

"Please go back. I don't want to see you get hurt."

Albert: Light is the strongest dragoon of the White Dragon Knights, and uses his impressive swordsmanship to fight any enemy that dares to challenge him.
He has trained for a certain goal and the proof of his tough training is shown in his battered jacket.
I can't tell you what his goal is, so that's up to you to find out.
But he's the cold and quiet type, so I'm not sure if he'll talk to you.
He doesn't laugh often and his eyes can be quite scary, but he is great at doing chores and likes taking care of people, so I hope you two can get along.

[Official in-game description]
